beats.intent: The product UI arrives, calm and complete

board.start: Empty light canvas, nothing on screen
board.end: Headline above a centred browser frame showing the October close header and one large chart
board.why: the viewer meets the whole product, calm and complete, before anything moves

beats.intent: Cursor clicks Reconcile all; the camera leans in

board.start: Cursor enters from the lower left, Reconcile all idle
board.end: Cursor rests on Reconcile all, ripple fired, camera leaned in on the button
board.why: the click is the cause; the finale is its effect, so it must come first

beats.intent: The button takes over the screen and resolves to logo and CTA (1.2s hold)

board.start: Iris wipe opens the brand canvas around the button
board.end: Mark, headline and CTA sharp and centred on the brand colour
board.why: the result of the click becomes the message; the CTA holds still for the full 1.2s
